mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs as corporate revenue expectations fall, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contractions (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing output declines signal rising recession risks that depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC for INDPRO < 100 falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1700 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1700 for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS growth) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS grows, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and industrial production declines signal monetary tightening combined with economic weakness, triggering equity market underperformance and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually), central bank policy tightening reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 3.0% falls below 0.03.
